concerns.text: Missing task for FR-008 (CPU-only hardware constraint). The spec mandates operation on CPU-only hardware, but no task explicitly verifies or enforces this constraint (e.g., checking for GPU device availability or forcing CPU-only flags in PyTorch).

Missing task for SC-005 (Robustness measurement). The spec requires measuring the standard deviation of R² across multiple runs, but no task explicitly calculates or reports this metric in the final results.

Missing task for FR-006 (Grad-CAM subset size). The spec requires generating heatmaps for 'at least 10 test images', but Task T042 only verifies generation for a single sample image, lacking a task to enforce the minimum subset size.

Missing task for Constitution Principle VII (Per-family metrics). The Constitution requires reporting performance metrics (R², MAE, RMSE) separately for each alloy family, but no task explicitly implements this stratified reporting logic.

Stale/Redundant Task T047a and T047b. Task T047a (benchmark pipeline) is listed in Phase N, but T007a (Optional benchmark pipeline) already exists in Phase 2. This creates ambiguity about when the benchmark should be run and duplicates the intent without clear differentiation.
